newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-US gas find fuels Bligh Oil shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-US gas find fuels Bligh Oil shares.

text.p: Shares in oil and gas explorer Bligh Oil and Minerals NL soared at the opening on Wednesday, jumping 48 percent to an early intraday high of A$0.51 after announcing on Tuesday that it had encountered a major gas zone in the first well drilled in the Morrow gas play in Texas.

Bligh said it was not possible to accurately estimate gas reserves until production testing and pressure build-up analysis had been completed, but noted that gas reserves in comparable wells in the immediate area ranged from 20-50 billion cubic feet of gas per well.
"Bligh has found one of the widest intersections ever encountered in this area so the find has a lot of potential," a Sydney-based resource analyst said.

The shares of Omega Oil NL were also affected by the find on Tuesday as it has a five percent stake in the area. At 10.30 a.m. (2330 GMT), Omega shares were steady at 14 cents after rising two cents on Tuesday.
